summary: Version 1.1.0 adds four illustrative organization arrangements to the October 23, 2026 edition 1.0.0.

changes.section: 1.5 Match the structure to your coordination needs
changes.text: Added four illustrative organization arrangements, from one team to federated business units, after the discussion of shared expertise.
changes.rationale: Helps leaders choose coordination and support arrangements while preserving team ownership. Company sizes are examples, not prescribed transition points.

changes.text: Removed decimal prefixes from website and Markdown subsection headings. Section references now link to the visible titles, matching the PDFs.
changes.rationale: Both PDF appearances were reissued with this correction recorded.
